body: Blueface and ChriseanRock are seemingly back on good terms AGAIN, after the two were recently spotted together looking more like a couple. The unexpected sighting has people talking, especially considering it comes just days after Chrisean reportedly covered up her tattoo of Blueface’s name with a White House tattoo. The timing has raised eyebrows, with many wondering whether the two are working toward rekindling their relationship or simply spending time together again.
